ui.settings.title: HUD settings
ui.settings.locationHint: Sits above the minimap and only shows while the minimap is visible. Use “Move HUD” to shift it; it stays anchored to the minimap across resolutions.
ui.settings.moveHint: Drag the HUD. It always stays inside the safe zone.

ui.diag.waiting: On. Get in a vehicle to see samples.

ui.diag.reason.not_allowed: discarded: vehicle or category without ejection
ui.admin.title: HUD administration
ui.admin.saved: Saved and applied to every player ({n} changes).
ui.admin.invalid: Some values are invalid; nothing was saved.
ui.admin.defaultsApplied: Defaults loaded for this section. Press Save to apply them.
ui.admin.err.permission: No permission: the server rejected the change.
ui.admin.err.rate: Wait a moment before saving again.
ui.admin.g.Seatbelt.ejection.horizontalForc: Force: how the player is thrown
ui.admin.f.Seatbelt.ejection.minDelta: Velocity change to count as a crash
ui.admin.f.Seatbelt.lockExit: Block the exit key while buckled
ui.admin.h.Features.seatbelt: Off: no seatbelt or telltale. With an external seatbelt (qbx_seatbelt) only its state is shown.
ui.admin.h.Seatbelt.key: Default keys reach each player when they reconnect and never replace a key the player has customised.
ui.admin.h.Seatbelt.ejection.enabled: Own seatbelt mechanic only. Bicycles never eject.
ui.admin.h.Seatbelt.ejection.categories: Cars only by default. In categories without seatbelt (motorcycles…) occupants always count as unbuckled.
ui.admin.h.Seatbelt.ejection.allowModels: Spawn names that allow ejection even if their category is not ticked.
ui.admin.h.Seatbelt.ejection.denyModels: Spawn names that never eject (take priority).
ui.admin.h.Seatbelt.ejection.minSpeed: Threshold. The larger of the vehicle speed in the window and the velocity change. Below it there is never an ejection (also for hits received while stopped).
ui.admin.h.Seatbelt.ejection.minDelta: Threshold. Change of the velocity vector (km/h) inside the window: obstacle stops, rear or side hits and sudden direction changes. Collision evidence is also required.
ui.admin.h.Seatbelt.ejection.minRatio: Threshold. The change must be at least this share of the speed (avoids ejecting on braking, turns and high-speed scrapes).
ui.admin.h.Seatbelt.ejection.window: Threshold. A {d} km/h change in {w} ms is roughly {g} g. Jumps and teleports are discarded.
ui.admin.h.Seatbelt.ejection.horizontalForc: Force. The player keeps their inertia, opposite to the vehicle velocity change (frontal → forward, reversing → backward, side hit → out of the hit side). 1.00× = full inertia. Does not change when ejection happens.
ui.admin.h.Seatbelt.ejection.verticalForce: Force. Upward impulse added when thrown.
ui.admin.h.Seatbelt.ejection.damage: Only when extra damage is enabled.
ui.admin.h.Seatbelt.ejection.cooldown: Minimum time between two ejections of the same player.
ui.admin.h.Seatbelt.lockExit: Only blocks the exit key; never exits forced by other scripts.
ui.admin.h.Features.engine: Key permissions are still respected (qbx_vehiclekeys or Config.Engine.authorize).
ui.admin.h.Features.lights: Off: native game lights are used; the telltale still shows their state.
ui.admin.h.Cruise.step: In each player’s unit (km/h or mph).
ui.admin.h.Features.cruise: Never acts on aircraft or boats.
ui.admin.h.Nitro.consumption: Charge units per second of use.
ui.admin.h.Features.nitro: Category restrictions stay (no nitro on boats, aircraft or bicycles).
